1.web: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus according to the commandment of God our Savior, and Christ Jesus our hope;
1.asv: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus according to the commandment of God our Saviour, and Christ Jesus our hope;

2.web: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
2.asv: unto Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

3.web: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,
3.asv: As I exhorted thee to tarry at Ephesus, when I was going into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge certain men not to teach a different doctrine,

4.web: neither to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes, rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith—
4.asv: neither to give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questionings, rather than a dispensation of God which is in faith; so do I now.

5.web: but the goal of this command is love, out of a pure heart and a good conscience and sincere faith;
5.asv: But the end of the charge is love out of a pure heart and a good conscience and faith unfeigned:

6.web: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned aside to vain talking;
6.asv: from which things some having swerved have turned aside unto vain talking;

7.web: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say, nor about what they strongly affirm.
7.asv: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say, nor whereof they confidently affirm.

8.web: But we know that the law is good, if a man uses it lawfully,
8.asv: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully,

9.web: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for man slayers,
9.asv: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and unruly, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

10.web: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine;
10.asv: for fornicators, for abusers of themselves with men, for menstealers, for liars, for false swearers, and if there be any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine;

11.web: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
11.asv: according to the gospel of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

12.web: And I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service;
12.asv: I thank him that enabled me, even Christ Jesus our Lord, for that he counted me faithful, appointing me to his service;

13.web: although I was before a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
13.asv: though I was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: howbeit I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief;

14.web: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
14.asv: and the grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

15.web: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
15.asv: Faithful is the saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief:

16.web: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience, for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.
16.asv: howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me as chief might Jesus Christ show forth all his longsuffering, for an ensample of them that should thereafter believe on him unto eternal life.

17.web: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
17.asv: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

18.web: This instruction I commit to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which led the way to you, that by them you may wage the good warfare;
18.asv: This charge I commit unto thee, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which led the way to thee, that by them thou mayest war the good warfare;

19.web: holding faith and a good conscience; which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith;
19.asv: holding faith and a good conscience; which some having thrust from them made shipwreck concerning the faith:

20.web: of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I delivered to Satan, that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
20.asv: of whom is Hymenæus and Alexander; whom I delivered unto Satan, that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
